newsitem.title: NORWAY: France threatens to block NATO reform.
newsitem.headline: France threatens to block NATO reform.

text.p: French Defence Minister Charles Millon said on Wednesday Paris would abandon moves to return fully into NATO if demands for a distinct European identity within the Atlantic Alliance were not met.
Millon told reporters Paris wanted the two main regional commands to be headed by Europeans, saying this was an issue of "fundamental importance".

Progress on reform of the alliance's command structure to allow it to take on new post-Cold War missions and expand eastwards have stalled over French and U.S. disagreements on who should head the key southern command in Europe.
The U.S., which provides most of the alliance's military hardware, holds the top two positions -- head of the Atlantic command and the head of the European command.

France wants the next two down in the pecking order -- the southern and northern commands in Europe -- to be rotated among the European allies to give the European voice within the alliance "permanent and irreversible" visibility.
"If a certain number of conditions are not respected... France will stay in the position where she is now," Millon said.
